thread:
marco: Hey - hit a flaky ESM/CJS interop when bundling the JS SDK for an edge sample. Works on node, fails on Vercel Edge after vite build. Error: "TypeError: Cannot read property 'adapter' of undefined" when doing conditional import.
anya: can you paste the minimal repro and build flags?
marco: Minimal repro:
1) src/auth.ts does conditional dynamic import between ./adapters/legacy (default export) and ./adapters/modern (named export 'adapter')
2) Build with vite (ssr) + esbuild or with rollup -> sometimes runtime shape is { default: { adapter: fn } } and other times { adapter: fn }
3) runtime fails when code assumes mod.adapter
marco: failing snippet:
```ts
export async function pickAdapter() {
  const mod = await import('./adapters/modern')
  return mod.adapter
}
```
jeff: classic bundler interop. Different toolchains (vite/rollup/webpack) and tsconfig (esModuleInterop/allowSyntheticDefaultImports/module) produce different wrappers.
rita: quick consumer workaround: `const m = await import(path); const norm = m && (m.default ?? m); return norm.adapter ?? norm` — works but messy.
anya: SDK plan: ship adapters with both exports (`export default adapter; export { adapter }`) and add a tiny `normalizeImport` util in the SDK: `export function normalizeImport<T>(m:any):T { return m && (m.default ?? m) }` with TS signature. Document pattern for conditional imports.
jeff: also add a small samples repo with vite/rollup/webpack configs and tsconfig variants (esnext/commonjs, esModuleInterop true/false) so we can reproduce across permutations. Add a CI smoke that bundles with esbuild and asserts normalized shape.
marco: I'll scaffold `samples/dx-bundler-shapes` with minimal apps and a README showing repro steps. Will include a tiny webpack config that reproduces the "Unexpected token export in CJS" parse error too.
rita: for webpack note: set `{ test: /\\.m?js$/, type: 'javascript/auto' }` or mark module external. For vite use `ssr.external` or `build.rollupOptions.external`. Add these tips to the README.
anya: I'll open an SDK PR for the normalize util + typings and add CHANGELOG note. devx-bot: created ticket RW-999 "dx: normalize bundle import shapes + samples" and assigned to @anya and @marco.
marco: thanks — ping here if you find other odd shapes (double-wrapped default, missing __esModule) with exact bundler + tsconfig so we can expand tests.
